discovery.trending_audio: no trending audio — original room tone only. Trending sounds compete with the specificity of the claim and reduce perceived authenticity for B2B/DTC build-in-public content.
discovery.optimal_post_time: Tuesday 8:14am PST or Wednesday 11:02am PST — both within peak DTC-founder scroll windows (pre-standup and pre-lunch creative review blocks)
algorithm_tips: First 3 seconds must answer 'why should I keep watching' with a number, not a question — '22 hours, $297' beats 'are you tired of slow UGC?'
No trending audio. Original sound boosts watch-time on talking-head B2B content because the algorithm weights completion rate, and trending tracks cause swipe-out at the hook
Pin a 2nd comment within 60 seconds with raw timestamps — drives comment count, which is the second-strongest ranking signal
Loop the caption: end with a question that requires the same word to answer that you opened with
Repost at hour 48 to a different hook variant — TikTok treats cross-posted content from the same account as new when the audio is original
